aboutGame.title: What is Bunny Mummy?
paragraphs: Bunny Mummy is the spooky-cute mashup of a soft rabbit and an ancient bandaged mummy. In Fortnite it shows up as a limited-time cosmetic set - a wrapped-rabbit outfit with matching back bling and harvesting tool - while collectors also chase it as plush figures, display pieces, and community-made skins.

Because Bunny Mummy is a rotating cosmetic rather than a permanent store fixture, availability changes constantly. This wiki tracks where the look appears, how to unlock or earn it, what each bundle contains, and how to style it, so you never miss a shop reset or fall for a fake code.

modules.name: Bunny Mummy Beginner Guide
modules.description: New player guidance: what Bunny Mummy is, the first steps to unlock it, early tips, and the decisions that matter most in your first session.

highlights.detail: Confirm which Bunny Mummy you are chasing - a Fortnite cosmetic, a plush, or a community skin - before spending time or V-Bucks.
Check the official event calendar and note the exact start and end dates so a rotating window never closes on you.
Bank your event currency and V-Bucks early instead of grinding during the final two days of the event.
Complete the quest chain in order, since side objectives often gate the final Bunny Mummy reward.
Verify any code or trade through official sources before you commit - most secret code lists are fake or expired.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common Bunny Mummy questions about unlocking, bundles, prices, and shop returns.

items.question: What is Bunny Mummy?
items.answer: Bunny Mummy is a spooky-cute character concept that fuses a soft rabbit with an ancient bandaged mummy. It appears as a limited-time Fortnite cosmetic set, and also as plush collectibles and community-made skins in other games.

items.question: How do I get Bunny Mummy in Fortnite?
items.answer: Watch the Item Shop, which refreshes at 00:00 UTC, and buy the set during a rotation. Seasonal events such as Fortnitemares and their quest chains are the other reliable route - Bunny Mummy is not a permanent store item.

items.question: How much does the Bunny Mummy bundle cost?
items.answer: Pricing varies by bundle, but a full set usually groups the outfit, back bling, and harvesting tool together for better value than buying each piece separately. Check the current shop listing before you spend V-Bucks.

items.question: Are Bunny Mummy codes real?
items.answer: Most secret Bunny Mummy code lists are fake or expired. Treat any code that asks for your login, payment, or a survey as a scam, and confirm rewards only through official channels.

items.question: When will Bunny Mummy return to the shop?
items.answer: Epic rotates cosmetics on its own schedule and does not announce every return in advance. Check the daily reset at 00:00 UTC and track community shop-sighting threads to catch the next Bunny Mummy rotation.
